sites.ownership: The editor palette grid owns its programmatic-sync guard.
sites.justification: Opening or refreshing editor palette tiles must update state without recursively writing GSettings.

sites.ownership: The editor palette grid owns its preview tile set.
sites.justification: Editor palette preview tiles are built dynamically and refreshed when app appearance or palette settings change.

sites.ownership: The window palette grid owns its programmatic-sync guard.
sites.justification: Opening or refreshing window palette tiles must update state without recursively writing GSettings.

sites.ownership: The window palette grid owns its chrome preview tile set.
sites.justification: Window palette preview tiles are built dynamically and refreshed when app appearance, editor palette, or window palette settings change.

sites.ownership: The per-window chrome controller tracks the currently classed primary-menu popover.
sites.justification: Popover classing must be idempotent across menu rebuilds and must remove the scoped class from stale popover instances.

sites.ownership: The per-window chrome controller owns its signal and settings subscriptions.
sites.justification: Per-window handlers must stay alive while the window exists and disconnect during controller drop to avoid global signal leaks.
